Questions about the Growth Index.

Time, privacy and what you get.

How long does the Growth Index take?

About twenty minutes for you, plus a short assessment for each of your leaders.

Will my leaders see my ratings?

No. Your ratings stay with you, and your leaders never see them.

What do I get from the Growth Index, and when?

Once your leaders finish their short assessments, a LeadShift partner walks you through your report, leader by leader. Then you get a plan for the gap: team gap, leader gap, or both, with a clear scope and a price.

What do profile fit and seat fit measure?

Profile fit compares how each leader naturally works with the leadership your five priorities call for. Seat fit compares it with what their current role needs. Both describe fit, not ability or potential, and a partner reads them alongside your own ratings.

    Questions CEOs ask us.

    Straight answers to what CEOs want to know before they call.

    Something else on your mind? or call (508) 778-1300.

    Why does every decision still end up on my desk?

    Usually because the people around you aren't set up to make it. Leaders without clear ownership send decisions up. A leadership team that avoids hard debate revisits decisions instead of standing behind them. Frontline managers who were never taught to manage pass problems up the line. Each has a different fix, and the Growth Index shows which one you have.

    Start the Growth Index

    Is the problem my leadership team, or the leaders on it?

    Look at where things break. If capable leaders run their own areas well but the team struggles to debate, commit and hold each other accountable, the gap is the team. ALIGN works on that, with a team assessment at the start and the end, workshops on trust, conflict, commitment, accountability and results, and coaching for the team leader. If the team works well together but some leaders aren't ready for what the business needs next, the gap is the leaders, and the Leadership Academy develops them in a cohort. Often it's both. For one leadership team, that usually means ALIGN plus seats in an open Leadership Academy cohort.

    How ALIGN works

    My best performer got promoted and is struggling as a manager. What now?

    It's a common story: being great at the work doesn't teach anyone to run a team. New managers need a simple system for one-on-ones, goals, accountability, recognition and hard conversations, and they need to understand how each person on their team is wired. ASCEND, LeadShift's program for frontline managers, builds both, with behavioral assessments for each manager and their people and coaching along the way.

    Should I develop the leaders I have or replace them?

    Start by checking whether they've had a fair shot: clear expectations, the authority to act and real support. Low ratings for a leader who closely matches the role often point to one of those, and that's fixable. When the gap holds after those are in place, a different seat or a change can be the right call for the company and for the leader. The Growth Index puts your ratings beside each leader's match to the role, so the decision rests on more than instinct.

    What does leadership development cost?

    It depends on the program, how many leaders take part, how much one-on-one coaching runs alongside the group work, and how long it runs. ALIGN, for a leadership team, runs $50,000 to $75,000 over six months. The Leadership Academy is $15,000 to $18,000 per leader for a nine-month cohort. ASCEND is $4,000 to $6,000 per frontline manager over four months. Executive coaching is $18,000 for six months. Performance coaching, which focuses a leader on one goal, and sales coaching are $5,000 per sprint.

    See the program ranges

    How do we know it's working?

    LeadShift measures where you start and where you finish. ALIGN gives the team the same team assessment at the beginning and the end, and sets performance measures with the team leader up front. ASCEND scores each manager on the management system before and after. Those numbers sit beside what you see your leaders doing differently.

    What is the Growth Index?

    A complimentary assessment for CEOs. You choose the five of twelve leadership priorities your strategy depends on and rate each leader privately, and each leader completes a short behavioral assessment. It shows whether your gap is how the team works together, how your leaders are growing, or both.

    CEOs and leadership teams of growing companies. Since 1997, LeadShift has worked with more than 200 organizations, many of them for more than a decade. Clients are concentrated in financial services, insurance, life sciences and manufacturing.
